bio: I study civil engineering at NITK Surathkal, but most of my time goes into writing software. That started in 2021, when I built Arjun Guruji, an app for SNSDS Trust. More than 2,000 people have installed it, and I still look after it.

These days I lead the four-person web team on Osdag at FOSSEE, IIT Bombay. Osdag is open-source software that engineers use to design steel connections, so the job sits right between the two things I know. Before the web version went live, I ran a load test with more than 20 people sending 200+ requests at once, and set up the production servers from what it showed.

Outside of that I mostly build backends: a retail data platform on Spark and Delta Lake, a process-mining service in Spring Boot, and a monitoring tool that sends a Discord alert when a server stays over its limits. I graduate in 2027 and I'm looking for a software engineering role.
